title: Lower: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Inchworm Push-Up × 6 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Quick off the floor, stiff ankles
strength: Tempo 3-1-1: 3 sec down, 1 sec pause · Rest 2:00

cond.subtitle: 4 rounds · new station every minute
cond.scaling: Bike taken? 40-sec run · cut reps to keep 15 sec rest

note: Squat depth before squat weight. If the pause breaks your position, the load is too heavy.
